title: Dyess Lanes Walk-In Refrigerator
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR FORCE GLOBAL STRIKE COMMAND.FA4661  7 CONS CD
description_text: The requirement is for the procurement and installation of a custom outdoor walk-in refrigeration system consisting of a combination freezer, cooler, and dry storage unit. This will include Refrigeration systems (multiple BTU-rated units), doors, partitions, lighting, rain canopy, and anchors. The installation process will consist of the removal/disposal of existing unit, full system install, refrigerant charging, startup, and calibration.
